summary.headline: Enchem: Largest shareholder Wyatt Group pledges 678,405 shares as collateral for KRW 16.5bn loan
summary.what_happened: On Nov 23, 2026, Enchem Co., Ltd. filed a corrected disclosure stating that its largest shareholder, Wyatt Group Co., Ltd., entered into a new share pledge agreement covering 678,405 common shares (3.10% stake) as collateral, with a secured amount of KRW 16.5bn in favor of Oasis Second Private Investment Limited Partnership (CB issuance purpose). The filing states the correction reflects the termination of the prior share-backed loan with Meritz Securities, which had covered 784,622 shares (3.58%) with a loan balance of KRW 23.14bn.
summary.why_it_matters: Share pledges by a largest shareholder are disclosed because, if the borrower defaults or margin requirements are not met, the pledged shares may be sold or transferred, which could change the identity of the largest shareholder. Investors typically watch such filings for the possibility of ownership changes resulting from enforcement.
